skill.name: list-sw-dev-file-trees-en
skill.description: Generates or refreshes a ranked list of the 25 most-used file tree structures in software development, writing the result as a formatted Markdown table into README.md and appending a dated entry to CHANGELOG.md. Activate when asked to "update the file tree list", "refresh the README", "regenerate the sw dev trees", or when run by the bi-weekly GitHub Actions workflow in awesome-sw-dev-trees.
